# CritiCore

> News and honest reviews for games, movies, and series — community-driven, multilingual, and ad-light.

CritiCore is a media review platform where users rate and review games, movies, and TV series. It aggregates metadata from TMDB, RAWG, and OMDB, supports press-tier publishing, polls, news articles, a public API, and a collaborative editor (Redaim). Available in German, English, French, Spanish, and Thai.

## Pages

- [Home](/de-DE/): Trending movies, series, games, and latest news.
- [Explore](/de-DE/entdecken): Discover media across all categories.
- [Movies](/de-DE/filme): Browse and review movies.
- [Series](/de-DE/serien): Browse and review TV series.
- [Games](/de-DE/games): Browse and review games.
- [News](/de-DE/news): Editorial news and patch notes.
- [Polls](/de-DE/umfragen): Community polls on media topics.
- [Forum](/de-DE/forum): Community discussions (currently coming soon).
- [Developers / API](/de-DE/developers): CritiCore Public API v3 documentation.
- [Support](/de-DE/support): Help center and ticket submission.
- [Donate](/de-DE/spenden): Support the project.
